title: Remove the history events a command published when its save is refused because the session file vanished, and test that session use waits for stage advance (issue 82)
description: Remove the history events a command published when its save is refused because the session file vanished, and test that session use waits for stage advance (issue 82)
acceptance_criteria: A stage advance whose session file is moved away during its native read refuses with nothing saved and leaves no new event file. Session use started during a stage advance waits for it. Each new test fails where stated and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Bounded fix for issue 82 as Leif chose on 2026-11-04 (test the lock and clean up); stacked on 77 at 75a732d; only events this command published and whose bytes are unchanged are removed; any other failed save keeps the unselected orphan of REQ-history-002
